# Candidate Profile — Rohan Mehta

Location: San Francisco, USA
Email: rohan.mehta.ai@gmail.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0148

## Summary

GenAI/LLM engineer with 4 years of experience shipping retrieval-augmented
generation systems to production. Currently a GenAI Engineer at Lumen AI.

## Employment history

GenAI Engineer — Lumen AI (2023-02 – present)
Built the RAG pipeline serving the company's support-copilot product,
including the vector-store ingestion and re-ranking layer. Fine-tuned an
open-weights model for domain-specific tone and ran the eval harness that
gates every prompt-template change.

ML Engineer — Halcyon Data (2021-01 – 2023-01)
Built classical NLP pipelines in Python before the team's pivot to LLMs.
Owned the embedding-similarity search service backing the company's internal
knowledge base.

Software Engineer Intern — Lattice Works (2020-06 – 2020-12)
First internship; built internal tooling in Python for the data team.

## Education

B.S. Computer Science — University of California, San Diego (2016–2020)

## Skills

Python, LLM Fine-tuning, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Vector Databases, PyTorch,
LangChain

# Job Description — GenAI Engineer

Location: San Francisco (interview is in-person where possible)
Experience level: 3+ years

## Must-have skills

- Python
- LLM Fine-tuning
- RAG
- Prompt Engineering

## Nice-to-have skills

- Vector Databases
- PyTorch
- LangChain

## Role summary

We're hiring a GenAI engineer to own our retrieval-augmented generation
stack — ingestion, vector search, prompt templates, and the eval harness
that gates changes before they ship.

## What we're screening for

- Demonstrated ownership of a production RAG or LLM-serving pipeline, not
  just a prototype notebook
- Comfort with prompt-template iteration backed by an actual eval process
- Bonus: experience fine-tuning open-weights models
